bottleneck.description: One of the largest vertical lift module (VLM) / vertical carousel vendors with global reach via Kardex Remstar, competing with Modula, SSI Schaefer Logimat, Hänel and System Logistics in a product category with low switching cost.

dependency.key_customers: Manufacturing plants (Bosch, Siemens, automotive Tier-1s), MRO operations, healthcare distribution, e-commerce SKU pickers, Amazon US fulfillment (recently)
dependency.key_suppliers: Steel structures and tray suppliers, servo motors (Siemens, ABB), PLCs (Siemens, Rockwell), Mitsubishi/Fanuc controllers, lift hardware

editorial.notes: VLMs are a discrete product class served by a roughly six-vendor field — Kardex Remstar, Modula, SSI Schaefer, Hänel, Ferretto, ICAM — with near-identical specs and pricing. Buyers cross-shop on price, service network and software integration; substitution is straightforward at the unit-purchase level. The recent AutoStore acquisition (Kardex bought Vertical Industries / Mlog and the AutoStore integrator footprint) expanded scope but not into a bottleneck position. Maps to LOW (peer-competitive intralogistics).
